hypothesis: A zero-initialized 96-bin WKB residual trained on truth-P_bg will improve independent same-medium Marmousi source confirmation by at least 20% over the fixed current-manifest P_bg baseline within 2000 updates, while preserving fit and calibration nonworse behavior.
expected_mechanism: The fixed LWC84 background provides source-aware phase, onset and causality at 0.134-0.174 held-out error. The learned branch only needs the smaller heterogeneous scattering correction and starts from exact abstention.
literature_basis: Hybrid numerical-neural correction is the highest-ranked project hypothesis after source-mapper failures. The coarse solve separates physical propagation from learned fine-scale closure.

single_conceptual_variable.name: learned_scattering_residual_on_fixed_pbg
single_conceptual_variable.candidate: P_bg plus zero-init learned truth-P_bg residual
single_conceptual_variable.held_constant: current source data, sigma-2 cache, source panels, r20 front-end, 96-bin WKB head, frequency gate, optimizer, learning rates, seed and metric

panels.confirmation_truth_access: opened once after checkpoint selection is frozen

primary_metric: all-saved confirmation relative L2 versus fixed P_bg baseline
failure_signal: Reject if confirmation improves by less than 20%, fit or calibration regresses more than 5%, predicted scattering remains near zero, or any non-finite/OOM/cache/binding/resource failure occurs.
rollback: Preserve P_bg, r20 and r29 artifacts. Do not open validation/test_id or tune cache sigma from this run.
